name: Ashkrit Sharma
tagline: Building scalable platforms, data-driven products, and the architecture underneath agentic AI systems.
bio: I lead engineering teams that build payment platforms at scale — the kind where latency budgets are measured in microseconds and correctness is not negotiable.

For over a decade I have written at Are you ready about what actually happens inside systems: lock-free data structures, garbage collection, JVM performance, distributed databases and stream processing. More recently the writing has turned to LLMs and agentic systems — how they reason, where they break, and what they do to the economics of software.
Most of what I learn ends up in a blog post or a repository. Both are below.
